approach: automatic expansion of manual baseline and feature selection in a specified search space
generation: Buy counts for user/item/user-item over 7/14/30/60 days strictly before cutoff; calendar manual features retained

limits: Correlated manual features and neighboring windows may substitute for one another.
Low importance does not prove absence of useful information.
Positive mean over three shuffles is not a statistical significance test.
Row-wise shuffling breaks within-user-month and within-item-month aggregate constancy.
Selection by LogLoss does not guarantee better Recall or NDCG.

catalog_coverage.definition: unique client-asset-month Buy triples inside catalog / all assets for cohort

repeat_definition: positive pair with Buy in preceding 3 calendar months strictly before cutoff
new_definition: positive pair without Buy in same 3-month window, not lifetime first purchase
group_evaluation: original top-5; recall within eligible group cases; never rerank on labels/groups; do not average group recalls to recover overall recall

bootstrap.estimand: macro Recall difference across eligible user-months with client multiplicity
bootstrap.empty_draws: null difference, excluded from percentiles, counted explicitly

experiment_budget.feature_generation_and_selection: 12 generated candidates, one selector fit, 52 permutation-score predictions
experiment_budget.model_tuning: four selected-set configurations; all-17 and manual control excluded from winner selection
experiment_budget.counting_unit: fits per full execution; verification reruns repeat the same configurations

conclusions: Создано 12 кандидатов; добавлено 5 к пяти ручным, всего 10 признаков.
Выбраны настройки 100/7; прежний отбор совпал: True, настройки совпали: True.
Добавление всех 17 при 100/7 меняет Recall на +0.0044.
Отбор при 100/7 меняет Recall относительно всех 17 на +0.0101.
Отобранный набор против ручных пяти при 100/7: разница Recall +0.0145.
Выбранные модели: ручной Recall 0.6205, автоматический 0.6227; разница +0.0023.
Для выбранных моделей ΔLogLoss=-0.00032 (меньше лучше); ΔPrecision=-0.0017; ΔNDCG=-0.0049.
Метрики характеризуют разные стороны прогноза; автоматическую модель нельзя назвать лучшей по всем метрикам.
Сохраняем ручную основу; это автоматическое расширение и эвристический отбор в заданном пространстве, не полный отказ от ручного проектирования.
Группа new_3m: ручной Recall 0.2767, автоматический 0.2902, наблюдаемая разница +0.0135; отдельный интервал для группы не рассчитан.
Группа repeat_3m: ручной Recall 0.9256, автоматический 0.9252, наблюдаемая разница -0.0004; отдельный интервал для группы не рассчитан.
automatic_selected - manual_selected: Δ=+0.0023, 95% CI [-0.0174, +0.0214]; интервал включает ноль, устойчивое преимущество не подтверждено.
automatic_selected - pair_then_popularity: Δ=+0.0073, 95% CI [-0.0114, +0.0266]; интервал включает ноль, устойчивое преимущество не подтверждено.
selected_100_7 - manual_5_100_7: Δ=+0.0145, 95% CI [-0.0042, +0.0335]; интервал включает ноль, устойчивое преимущество не подтверждено.
В этом запуске 6 обучений: 1 отбор + 1 контроль всех признаков + 4 настройки + 0 ручной контроль; перестановки дают 52 вызова прогнозов дополнительно.
Test не оценивался. Исходные ограничения FAR-Trans, реконструкций и полноты ноября сохраняются.

metric_definitions.primary_population: user-months with at least one in-catalog positive
metric_definitions.Recall@5: mean(hits / in-catalog positive assets) over eligible user-months
metric_definitions.NDCG@5: mean(binary DCG / IDCG(min(R,5))) over eligible user-months; discount=1/log2(rank+1)
metric_definitions.Precision@5_all: mean(hits / 5) over all user-months, including zero positives
metric_definitions.LogLoss: mean binary negative log-likelihood over all candidate pairs; clip [1e-15,1-1e-15]
metric_definitions.ROC-AUC: global pair AUC over all candidates; null for one class or ranking-only method
metric_definitions.overall_aggregation: direct macro average over eligible user-months, not unweighted month averages

tie_break.payload: UTF-8 compact JSON [seed, customerID, YYYY-MM-DD, ISIN]
tie_break.order: criteria descending; digest ascending; ISIN ascending on collision

observation.reason: Repository collection period ends 29 November 2022; include that day, conservative exclusive next day

limits: Fixed cohort of existing clients and fixed catalog; asset availability not modeled.
Coverage denominator includes out-of-catalog buys; ranking metrics do not.
Zero means no recorded buy, not an explicit dislike; no exposure data.
Source reconstructed events and date changes may use future information; timestamp filters do not fully remove this limitation.
No independent advantage claim from validation selection and diagnostic bootstrap.
Calendar checks do not establish event completeness for each client and asset.
November test month is not fully supported by repository collection boundary; documentation clarification required before final evaluation.
Earlier experimental count and manual feature design/selection cost unknown; monthly repeats protocol differs from paper.
No profitability, suitability or causal recommendation-effect assessment.
Correlated manual features and neighboring windows may substitute for one another.
Low importance does not prove absence of useful information.
Positive mean over three shuffles is not a statistical significance test.
Row-wise shuffling breaks within-user-month and within-item-month aggregate constancy.
Selection by LogLoss does not guarantee better Recall or NDCG.
Manual five features are retained; generation/search space and selection cap are human specified.
Group differences are observed diagnostics without separate uncertainty intervals.
history_protocol: rolling history before monthly cutoff; fixed train-fitted model during validation; repeats allowed
label_definition: at least one Buy in target calendar month; pair-month duplicates count once
selection_rule: max Recall@5, then min LogLoss, then min max_iter, then min max_leaf_nodes
